title: Supplier reconciliation evidence
question: The review board has been shown tool-call success logs. What should it ask for before relying on the assistant to explain invoice mismatches?
review_focus: Distinguish tool execution from correctness of the explanation. Preserve the diagnosed-failure denominator and judge whether the proposed review would catch bad synthesis or premature stopping.

title: Field photography transfer and cost
question: Can the image-compression result inform a decision about sending fewer bytes from field sites, and what would justify a change if some photos are also needed for later human review?
review_focus: Keep bitrate and visual-question accuracy distinct from actual spend, latency and human evidence quality. Name a comparison that tests both uses and surface assumptions about when the question is known.

title: Operations planning under revised inputs
question: A staffing team has good one-shot forecast scores for its assistant. What additional evidence should it require before using the assistant during a planning meeting where forecasts and constraints can change?
review_focus: Use the multi-turn finding to formulate a concrete revision or state-tracking test. Avoid claiming that the benchmark establishes savings or validates staffing decisions.

title: Workplace training feedback
question: Should an internal training team select a feedback assistant based on how many comments it makes? What evidence would give a better basis for choosing a feedback workflow?
review_focus: Distinguish annotation correspondence from learner outcomes. Look for a way to compare missed priority feedback and unnecessary comments using an appropriate internal reference.

title: Cold-chain alert policy
question: A vendor says a live data feed makes continuous model updates necessary. How should an operations team decide between a fixed detector and adaptive updates after a warehouse sensor change?
review_focus: Treat the static advantage as a benchmark result, preserve the drift question, and identify evidence about the actual sensor change and alert errors. Avoid a blanket choice or a compliance claim.
